checks.name: Hydration preserves pin aliases and manual bends while deferring auto routes
Exact versioned cache round-trips and save snapshots include it without runtime data
Version, geometry, pin, obstacle, connection and bend changes invalidate cache
Runtime and selection updates retain an in-flight job and its authored references
Replacement, reset and explicit cancellation ignore late worker messages
Edits and undo coalesce a replacement job and obsolete results never overwrite edits
Worker error and invalid responses retain data and can be retried
No-auto and legacy-straight documents retain the load contract
